mapper.select: /*master.mpds.selectMpDsDbOffPoHistoryList*/ SELECT ROWNUM AS NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER)AS BUYER_NM, P.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_NO, DECODE(P.OPKG_SEQ, NULL, (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=P.BUYER_ITEM_NO), (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM DONGOPKG WHERE BYCA_COMORG_CODE=P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=P.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND RD_DATE=P.OPKG_RD_DATE AND OPKG_SEQ=P.OPKG_SEQ) ) AS DESCRIPTION, DECODE(H.COLUMN_NM, 'AGENT','공급사 변경', 'REF_NO','관리코드 변경', 'REMARK','비고 변경') AS COLUMN_NM, DECODE(H.COLUMN_NM, 'AGENT',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.OLD_VALUES), H.OLD_VALUES) AS OLD_VALUES, DECODE(H.COLUMN_NM, 'AGENT',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.NEW_VALUES), H.NEW_VALUES) AS NEW_VALUES, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = H.CHANGE_USER_ID )AS USER_ID, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(H.CHANGE_DATE||H.CHANGE_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHANGE_DATE FROM DB_OFF_PO_HISTORY H , DB_OFF_PO P WHERE H.BUYER = P.BUYER AND H.SEQ = P.SEQ AND H.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND H.SEQ = #{st_seq}
